## Description

Couples Neural Controlled Differential Equations (Neural CDEs) with stochastic jump-diffusion processes to capture continuous tick-level price paths and sudden liquidity jump shocks in limit order books.

## Where it may fit

High-frequency limit order book forecasting, flash crash detection, tick-level derivative pricing.

## Vehicles

High-Frequency Trading Firms, Quantitative Market Making Desks.

## Required data

Millisecond limit order book level 2/3 message streams, trade execution timestamps, quote depths.

## Caveats

Requires GPU acceleration and specialized numerical solvers to handle continuous path controls and jumps simultaneously.
